Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_count number;
 l_coll_date_local date;
 l_sysdate_local date;
begin
 begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 
 
 if is_timezone_enabled then -- by jairam. IM 5199. converting coll_Date to local time. on 14-apr-2011
 
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, :ctrl_blk_2.coll_date, l_coll_date_local);
 
 else
 l_coll_date_local := :ctrl_blk_2.coll_date;
 end if; 
 
 
 if is_timezone_enabled then -- by jairam. comverting sysdate to local time.
 
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate, l_sysdate_local);
 
 else
 l_sysdate_local := sysdate;
 end if; 
 
 -- now compare coll date which is in local time and sysdate which is in local time
 
 -- if trunc(:ctrl_blk_2.coll_date) > trunc(sysdate)
 if trunc(l_coll_date_local) > trunc(l_sysdate_local)
 then
 show_error('0060');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 
 select count(*) into temp_count
 from units
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:ctrl_blk_2.coll_date)
 --IM# 5127 and to_date(trunc(coll_date), 'dd-mon-yyyy') = to_date(:global.coll_date, 'dd-mon-yyyy')
 and qc_label_date is null;

--message('GMT coll_date value for ctrl_blk_2.coll_date : ' ||:ctrl_blk_2.coll_date);pause;
--message('GMT coll_date value is : '||:global.coll_date);pause; --MS
--message('temp_count value is : ' || temp_count);pause;
 if temp_count != 1
 then
 :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id := '';
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('1145');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
end;

Trigger.Name: ON_ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 disp_format_mask varchar2(50);
begin
 if :Global.Error_count ='N' then 
 :Global.Error_count:='Y';
 if error_code in (50002,50003,50004, -- invalid date
 50011,50012,50021,50023,50025,50026,0) then
 if upper(substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),1,2)) ='FX' then
 disp_format_mask:=substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),3);
 else
 disp_format_mask:= get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK);
 end if;
 disp_format_mask := translate(disp_format_mask, 'R', 'Y');
 show_error('0022',disp_format_mask);
 elsif error_code in (50017,50018,50019,50022) then -- invalid time
 show_error('5016');
 end if;
 else
 null;
 end if; 
end;

declare

 temp_inter_type VARCHAR2(1);
 temp_inter_code VARCHAR2(4);
 temp_time_difference VARCHAR2(15);
 
 v_gmt_time date;
 v_gmt_time1 date;

 cursor c1 is
 select distinct product_code
 from components
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id 
 and trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:ctrl_blk_2.coll_date)
 --IM# 5127 and to_date(trunc(coll_date), 'dd-mon-yyyy') = trunc(to_date(:global.coll_date, 'dd-mon-yyyy'))
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 product_code != 'NONE';
 /* If there is a change in the weights or the
 time of centrigfuging and if the component has
 been pooled or relabeled, then a new
 interdictions will not be assigned to this
 component or an old interdiciton will not be
 removed. This will have to be done manually. */
begin
 execute_trigger('validate_record');
 check_package_failure;
 savepoint all_clear;
 begin
 select distinct 'x' into :GLOBAL.x
 from equipment
 where chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_2.chapter_id
 and equip_type = 'CENT'
 and equip_id in (:first_sep_centrifuge_id,:second_sep_centrifuge_id)
 and nvl(status,'x') != 'IN'
 and sysdate between first_production_date
 and nvl(last_production_date, sysdate);
 temp_status := sbclib.unit_system_interdiction(:ctrl_blk_2.unit_id,
 :ctrl_blk_2.coll_date,
 --IM# 5127 to_date(:global.coll_date, 'dd-mon-yyyy'), --MS
 :ctrl_blk_2.chapter_id,
 'CENT',
 :banner.user_id,
 :banner.prog_name);
 if nvl(temp_status,'x') != '0'
 then
 message('Centrifuge interdiction not assigned to unit.');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 delete from unit_interdictions
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id
 and trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:ctrl_blk_2.coll_date)
 --IM# 5127 and to_date(trunc(coll_date), 'dd-mon-yyyy') = trunc(to_date(:global.coll_date, 'dd-mon-yyyy'))
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and inter_code = (select inter_code
 from valid_interdictions_lab
 where system_inter_code = 'CENT'
 and sysdate between eff_date and
 nvl(term_date,sysdate+365));
 end;
 for temp_product in c1
 loop
 begin
 select time_limit, product_type
 into temp_time_limit, temp_product_type
 from valid_products
 where product_code = SUBSTR(temp_product.product_code,1,5) and
 unit_scheme_type = :GLOBAL.code_scheme and
 sysdate between eff_date and
 nvl(term_date,sysdate+365);
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 if temp_product_type in ('PLT','DUPLT')
 then
 if :first_sep_time is null or
 :second_sep_time is null
 then
 :GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id := :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_coll_date := :ctrl_blk_2.coll_date;
 --IM# 5127 :GLOBAL.user_err_coll_date := to_date(:global.coll_date, 'dd-mon-yyyy'); --MS
 :GLOBAL.user_err_product_code := temp_product.product_code;
 show_error('0138');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 if temp_product_type in ('WB','DUWB')
 then
 if :first_sep_time is not null
 then
 show_error('0260');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 if temp_product_type in ('FFP','RPL','RPFF',
 'DUFFP','DURPL','DURPF')
 then
 if :first_sep_time is null
 then
 :GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id := :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_coll_date := :ctrl_blk_2.coll_date;
 --IM# 5127 :GLOBAL.user_err_coll_date := to_date(:global.coll_date, 'dd-mon-yyyy'); --MS
 show_error('0083');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 if temp_product_type in ('RBC','DURBC','LEUKO','DULEU')
 then
 if :first_sep_time is null
 then
 :GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id := :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_coll_date := :ctrl_blk_2.coll_date;
 --IM# 5127 :GLOBAL.user_err_coll_date := to_date(:global.coll_date, 'dd-mon-yyyy'); --MS
 show_error('0084');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 if temp_time_limit is not null
 then
 if temp_product_type in ('RBC','DURBC','LEUKO','DULEU')
 then
 
 --MS Converting Local time to GMT.
 if IS_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 --Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_gmt_time(:global.chapter_id, :first_sep_time, v_gmt_time); -- commented by touqeer for IM# 5199
 --Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_gmt_time(:global.chapter_id, :second_sep_time_TEMP, v_gmt_time); -- Added by touqeer for IM# 5199 -- Commented by Kishore on 08/05/2014. SCR 20764

 --:global.first_sep_time_GMT := v_gmt_time;
 else
 --:first_sep_time := :first_sep_time;
 :first_sep_time := :first_sep_time_TEMP;
 end if;
 -- 
 
--Mush message('GMT time is :' ||to_char(v_gmt_time, 'MM/DD/YYYY HH24:MI') );pause;
--Mushtaq. Given by me raise form_trigger_failure;
 
/*MS 
 temp_time_difference :=
 sbclib.calculate_time(:bleed_start_time,
 :first_sep_time);
*/

--MS
 if v_gmt_time is not null then
 temp_time_difference :=
 sbclib.calculate_time(:bleed_start_time,v_gmt_time); 
 elsif v_gmt_time is null then
 temp_time_difference :=
 sbclib.calculate_time(:bleed_start_time, :first_sep_time_TEMP);
 --sbclib.calculate_time(:bleed_start_time, :first_sep_time); -- commented by touqeer for IM# 5199
 end if; 
--
 end if;
 if temp_product_type in ('PLT','DUPLT')
 then

 --MS Converting Local time to GMT.
 if IS_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 --Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_gmt_time(:global.chapter_id, :second_sep_time, v_gmt_time1); -- commented by touqeer for IM# 5199
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_gmt_time(:global.chapter_id, :second_sep_time_TEMP, v_gmt_time1); -- Added by touqeer for IM# 5199
 --:global.second_sep_time_GMT := v_gmt_time1;
 else
 --:second_sep_time := :second_sep_time;
 :second_sep_time := :second_sep_time_TEMP;
 end if;
 --

/*MS
 temp_time_difference :=
 sbclib.calculate_time(:bleed_start_time,
 :second_sep_time);
*/

--MS
 if v_gmt_time1 is not null then

 temp_time_difference :=
 sbclib.calculate_time(:bleed_start_time,
 v_gmt_time1);

 elsif v_gmt_time1 is null then

 temp_time_difference :=
 sbclib.calculate_time(:bleed_start_time,
 :second_sep_time);
 end if;
--

 end if;
 if temp_product_type in ('FFP','RPFF','DUFFP','DURPF')
 then

--MS
 --MS Converting Local time to GMT.
 if IS_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 --Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_gmt_time(:global.chapter_id, :first_sep_time, v_gmt_time); -- commented by touqeer for IM# 5199 
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_gmt_time(:global.chapter_id, :first_sep_time_TEMP, v_gmt_time); -- Added by touqeer for IM# 5199 
 else
 --:first_sep_time := :first_sep_time;
 :first_sep_time := :first_sep_time_TEMP;
 end if;
 --
 
 --MS Converting Local time to GMT.
 if IS_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 --Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_gmt_time(:global.chapter_id, :second_sep_time, v_gmt_time1); -- commented by touqeer for IM# 5199
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_gmt_time(:global.chapter_id, :second_sep_time_TEMP, v_gmt_time1); -- Added by touqeer for IM# 5199
 else
 :second_sep_time := :second_sep_time;
 end if;
 -- 
--

/*MS
 if :second_sep_time is not null
 then
 temp_time_difference :=
 sbclib.calculate_time(:bleed_start_time,
 :second_sep_time);
 else
 temp_time_difference :=
 sbclib.calculate_time(:bleed_start_time,
 :first_sep_time);
 end if;
*/

--MS 

 if v_gmt_time1 is not null then

 temp_time_difference :=
 sbclib.calculate_time(:bleed_start_time,
 v_gmt_time1);
 else
 temp_time_difference :=
 sbclib.calculate_time(:bleed_start_time,
 v_gmt_time);

 end if;
--

 end if;
 :GLOBAL.time_interdiction := 'N';
 if temp_time_difference is null
 then
 -- time difference is more than 999 hours or some
 -- other error
 message('Erroneous time difference');
 :GLOBAL.time_interdiction := 'Y';
 else
 temp_time_difference := ltrim(temp_time_difference);
 temp_time_difference :=
 substr(temp_time_difference,1,3)||'.'||
 to_char(round(to_number(
 substr(temp_time_difference,5,2))*100/60));
 if to_number(temp_time_difference) > temp_time_limit
 then
 :GLOBAL.time_interdiction := 'Y';
 end if;
 end if;
 end if;
 begin
 select count(*) into temp_count
 from component_interdictions
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:ctrl_blk_2.coll_date)
 --IM# 5127 and to_date(trunc(coll_date), 'dd-mon-yyyy') = trunc(to_date(:global.coll_date, 'dd-mon-yyyy')) --MS
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 product_code = temp_product.product_code and
 inter_code = (select inter_code
 from valid_interdictions_lab
 where system_inter_code = 'CMTI'
 and sysdate between eff_date and
 nvl(term_date,sysdate+365));
 if temp_count = 1
 then
 if :GLOBAL.time_interdiction = 'Y'
 then
 null;

 -- interdiction 'CMTI' is no more required
 delete from component_interdictions
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:ctrl_blk_2.coll_date)

 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 product_code = temp_product.product_code and
 inter_code = (select inter_code
 from valid_interdictions_lab
 where system_inter_code = 'CMTI'
 and sysdate between eff_date and
 nvl(term_date,sysdate+365));
 end if;
 else
 if temp_count = 0
 then
 if :GLOBAL.time_interdiction = 'Y'
 then
 -- interdiction 'CMTI' has to be created for
 -- the unit
 message('Msg:Component has CMTI interdiction');
 :GLOBAL.return_val :=
 sbclib.comp_system_interdiction(
 :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id,
 :ctrl_blk_2.coll_date ,
 --IM# 5127 to_date(:global.coll_date, 'dd-mon-yyyy'),
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 temp_product.product_code,
 'CMTI',:banner.user_id,
 :banner.prog_name);
 if :GLOBAL.return_val != '0'
 then

 to component');

 end if;
 end if;
 end if;
 end;
 end loop;
 :system.message_level := 5;
